title: The Little Mermaid - supplied reading excerpt

pages.text:
The next thing she knew, the Little Mermaid woke up. She had the prettiest legs on earth. And in front of her stood the handsome prince.

"Who are you" asked the Prince.
"Where do you come from?"
And the little mermaid could not speak, she could only look at the prince with her deep blue eyes.
